claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks are identified, assessed and monitored through a climate risk register.
claims.support_notes: Section explicitly states use of a climate risk register for identification, assessment and monitoring.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks in the register are assessed using a defined risk-rating methodology derived from a 5x5 risk matrix where risk score equals likelihood_score * severity_score and rating bands are: 1-2 low, 3-6 medium, 8-12 high, 15-25 critical (critical >= 15, high >= 8, medium >= 3, low < 3).
claims.support_notes: Methodology and thresholds are explicitly described in the section; no underlying register fields for severity_score/risk_rating derivation provided in evidence_items excerpt.

claims.claim_text: Inputs used in the assessment process include external climate indicators; physical risk exposure inputs reference ECB_climate_indicators as a data source.
claims.support_notes: Data source is named in the narrative; no separate evidence_item for ECB_climate_indicators shown in provided excerpt.

claims.claim_text: Scenario analysis is used to inform identification and assessment of climate-related risks, with individual risks linked to scenario analysis references including SCN0005, SCN0007, SCN0009 and SCN0011.
claims.support_notes: Narrative lists scenario IDs; evidence_items show scenario links for some risks (e.g., SCN0009, SCN0007). SCN0005 and SCN0011 not evidenced in excerpt.

claims.claim_text: The climate risk register includes risk descriptions to support identification and assessment.
claims.support_notes: Evidence item shows a populated risk_description field.

claims.claim_text: A risk described as "Chronic heat and shifting precipitation reduce yields for agricultural counterparties, weakening repayment capacity over the medium term." is rated medium.
claims.support_notes: Exact description and rating are present in evidence_items for climate_risk_register[10].

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks in the register are monitored at defined frequencies including monthly, quarterly and semi_annual cadences.
claims.support_notes: Evidence_items show examples of monthly, quarterly and semi_annual monitoring_frequency values.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks in the register are, in most cases, integrated into the entity’s overall enterprise risk management process, indicated by an ERM integration flag set to True for multiple registered risks.
claims.support_notes: Multiple risks show erm_integrated_flag=True in evidence_items; at least one shows False (index 5), consistent with "in most cases".

claims.claim_text: Some risks have changed since the prior period (changed_since_prior_period=True for selected risks) while others have not changed (changed_since_prior_period=False for selected risks).
claims.support_notes: Evidence_items include both True and False values across different register entries.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risk identification considers value chain segments including "Operational sites and travel" and "Lending to Other mining and quarrying" with associated example statements about emissions/physical disruption and transition risk from carbon pricing and demand shifts.
entities: Lending to Other mining and quarrying
claims.support_notes: Value chain segments and example narratives are stated in the section; no corresponding structured evidence_items shown in excerpt.

claims.claim_text: To support integrated risk management disclosures, climate-related risk identification, assessment and monitoring are presented on an integrated basis through the climate risk register and its linkage to scenario analysis references and external climate indicator inputs.
claims.support_notes: Narrative asserts integrated presentation and linkages; aligns with IFRS S2.26 anti-duplication guidance but does not evidence actual avoidance of duplication beyond the stated approach.

claims.claim_text: At least one registered risk has likelihood_score=4 and at least one has likelihood_score=5.
claims.support_notes: Evidence_items show likelihood_score values of 4 and 5 across multiple entries.
